original_review: Built-in tool output visibly inspected at generation; originals copied without resave.

method.sheet_display: 40px and 80px icons are pasted at exactly native pixel dimensions, not enlarged.

observations.whole_square: Complete pinched brown fedora, broad brim and dark hatband; warm ivory bandages; centered opaque black round goggles with brown rims; tan prosthetic nose; raised brown coat collar; ivory shirt/neckcloth and dark empty neck opening. No biological face or eyes added. The image preserves the supplied concept identity.
observations.full100_circle: Whole hat crown and brim, all bandaged head, goggles and prosthetic nose fit comfortably in the centered circle. Lower coat shoulders and neckcloth are truncated by the circle perimeter, as expected for a portrait. The hollow neck opening remains inside the circle.
observations.native_80: Hat, round dark goggles, pale head wrapping, tan nose and raised collar remain readable; hollow neck gap is visible but small. Bandage ridges and coat stitching mostly merge.
observations.native_40: The hat/goggle/bandage silhouette and dark-on-ivory eye area remain distinct. No biological eye details exist by design. Fine nose shape and linen folds soften; hollow neck identity is less apparent at this size.
observations.grayscale_320: Black goggles and dark neck gap remain distinct from ivory bandages/collar. Brown coat and hat remain visible by value and edges.
limitations: Hat crown starts about 12% down, closer to the top than the requested 18%; complete crown and brim still have generous clear circle margin.
Lower shoulders continue to square edges and are cut by the circle perimeter; neither hat nor head is clipped.
Plain charcoal background has slight studio luminance variation rather than proven pixel uniformity.
A small native40 circle cannot demonstrate the empty-neck geometry reliably. This is a proposed source, not runtime acceptance.
observations.recommendation: Keep g1 as source candidate for independent review.

generation_budget.note: No actual clipped-head or identity defect found; no correction call permitted for other refinements.

acceptance: No portrait runtime acceptance, asset import or model-stage advancement is made.
